question: What is the meaning of mass fraction of reused parts out of the total product mass in relation to reused content?
data_point: mass fraction of reused parts out of the total product mass
description: The meaning of mass fraction of reused parts out of the total product mass in relation to reused content is the proportion of the mass of parts in a product that have been reused compared to the total mass of the product. This indicates the percentage of the product that consists of reused components in relation to the overall product mass.
